translations.web: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
translations.bsb: They are all adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough.
translations.kjv: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
translations.asv: They are all adulterers; they are as an oven heated by the baker; he ceaseth to stir the fire, from the kneading of the dough, until it be leavened.
